findingDetails.title: Hub layout block calls the two browser trees packets and no packets in one line
findingDetails.case: A maintainer adding a fifth browser-facing mode reads the gloss, concludes the two trees are packets that lost their manifests, and edits mode-registry.json against the generated leaf-manifest.json.
findingDetails.scopeProof: One prose line in the hub; neither tree appears in mode-registry.json or leaf-manifest.json, so this line is the only statement of their status.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Rewording the gloss to state plainly that neither tree is a packet.

findingDetails.title: About 11,800 words load before task work and AGENTS.md duplicates registry precedence in prose
findingDetails.case: Epic shape stops force-routing in hub-router.json; fixtures pass because they replay the registry, while AGENTS.md:205 still states the old precedence and is read first.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Word counts measured on the four files the bootstrap chain names; the precedence rules exist in both AGENTS.md:205-224 and hub-router.json stageOneOrder; no reviewed file compares them.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: A read of check_hub.py showing it compares AGENTS.md precedence prose to hub-router.json.

findingDetails.title: Two incompatible vendoring models coexist and vendored packets have no local-edit path
findingDetails.case: An operator needs a one-line fix in a vendored reference; vendor-sync reports drift, push needs upstream commit rights, and doctor:overlay --capture never reaches outside .skilled.
findingDetails.scopeProof: vendor.json hash-pins each vendored file; the copied trees carry no .skilled directory or overlay lock; the hub routes every vendored change through push.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Either a documented and gated no-local-edit rule, or overlay support adopted for the two workflow packets.

findingDetails.title: Kernel review record cannot answer whether the Project kernel is current
findingDetails.case: A release reviewer asks whether the kernel was reviewed after the last skill change; the record says 0.8.0, the kernel H1 says v1.2.18, the hub says 1.0.28.0, and no field maps them.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The three version strings are read directly; the record is the only structured kernel-review artifact in the reviewed surface.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: A stated mapping such as kernelVersion copying the kernel H1 and alignedSkillVersion copying the hub version.

findingDetails.title: Parity note is 22,351 words in 136 lines with two headings, leaving the hand-parity method without an index
findingDetails.case: One paragraph changes in sk-product-owner/SKILL.md; the maintainer cannot address its row by heading in a 22k-word file, and the resulting edit sits inside a 4.3 KB line.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Line, word and heading counts measured on the file; no other parity map exists for the Claude Project package.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Heading-addressable rows per packet or per Project file, or evidence the workflow greps a stable key already.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The layout gloss assigns and denies packet status to the same two trees

searchActions.result: single line at :66 carries both claims

searchLedger.rationale: Prose is the only place the two trees' packet status is stated.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Routing precedence exists as prose in AGENTS.md and as policy in hub-router.json with no comparison gate

searchActions.result: Command Registry, Routing Compatibility, Document Loading Order, Full DAG all restate router content

searchLedger.rationale: Duplicated precedence with measured entry cost; gate coverage unverified so P2.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Two vendoring models coexist and the copied trees have no local-edit affordance

searchActions.result: per-file SHA-256 plus base_commit per package; include/exclude variants
twelve entries, no dotfiles, no .skilled directory or overlay lock
status/apply/repin with --capture to adopt one live edit

searchLedger.rationale: Answer to the operator question: overlay cannot replace vendor-sync, but the local-edit gap is real.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The kernel review record's versions cannot be compared to the kernel or hub versions

searchActions.result: kernelVersion 0.8.0, alignedSkillVersion 0.8.0, note says nothing reads the file
kernel H1 v1.2.18 versus hub version 1.0.28.0

searchLedger.rationale: Three version vocabularies with no mapping field.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The parity note is too large and too flat to navigate for its stated purpose

searchActions.result: 136 lines, 22351 words, longest line 4364 chars at line 108

searchLedger.rationale: Navigability at this size defeats the hand-parity purpose; non-ATX structure unmeasured and stated as a downgrade trigger.

searchLedger.invariant: Every packet carries the package files its kind requires, and no more.

searchActions.result: seven packets all carry SKILL.md, ROUTER.md, README.md, changelog/, manual-testing-playbook/, references/; feature-catalog only on tool packets

searchLedger.rationale: Tool-surface catalogs have no workflow counterpart; asymmetry follows packet kind, not an omission.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: shape difference explained by packet kind

searchLedger.hypothesis: The 0.8.0 record versions are stale drift

searchActions.result: the record self-describes as a dated point-in-time record at the named version

searchLedger.rationale: The record is honest about being historical; the actionable defect was refiled as the unanswerable comparison, not as drift.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: self-disclaimed historical record, not a false current claim

searchLedger.hypothesis: Playbook bodies have drifted from the capabilities their packets claim

searchActions.result: playbook present at hub root and in every packet; bodies not read this pass

searchLedger.rationale: Reading playbook bodies against capabilities needs its own budget; belongs to the traceability iteration.
searchLedger.deferredReason: body comparison deferred to the traceability pass
